name: a claim on an unmarked body writes the lane's marker after its text
a claim on an empty body writes the lane's marker alone
a claim takes the lane's release off
#4660: a claim written over another lane's under status:claimed keeps the earlier marker first
#5531: a claim over another lane's marker with no status:claimed takes the lapsed marker off and writes its own alone
#5531: a write that reads no labels is refused, as it cannot tell a live marker from a lapsed one
a run whose marker is the first keeps the claim
#4660: a run whose marker follows another lane's yields, its marker taken off
#4660: a run whose marker another write replaced yields with nothing to write back
#4839: a claim on a body quoting a marker in a code span leaves the quotation and writes its own
